title.zh: 将卡洛奥坎市Bagong Barrio描笼涯Bagong Barrio中学从第62描笼涯卡洛奥坎中学分离，改设为独立的Bagong Barrio国立中学，并为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Separating the Bagong Barrio High School in Barangay Bagong Barrio, Kalookan City, Metro Manila, From the Kalookan High School in Barangay Sixty-two, Also in Kalookan City, Metro Manila, and Converting It Into An Independent National High School to Be Known as the Bagong Barrio National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1995/ra_8118_1995.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The Bagong Barrio High School in Barangay Bagong Barrio, Kalookan City, Metro Manila, is hereby separated from the Kalookan High School in Barangay Sixty-two, also in Kalookan City, Metro Manila, and converted into an independent national high school to be known as the Bagong Barrio National High School.
The Secretary of Education, Culture and Sports shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary for the implementation of this Act.

The amount necessary for the implementation of this Act shall be charged against the current year's appropriations of the Kalookan High School. Thereafter, such sums as may be necessary for its operation and maintenance shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
